prompt: A clean straight-on photo of a city-hall election results board announcing the outcome of a RANKED-CHOICE (instant-runoff) contest among four candidates: Ash, Bray, Cole, and Dane. One hundred voters ranked them. First choices: Ash 34, Bray 28, Dane 21, Cole 17. Second and later preferences: every Cole ballot ranks Bray next; every Dane ballot ranks Cole next; every Bray ballot ranks Cole next. Instant-runoff eliminates the lowest candidate each round and transfers their ballots to the next surviving preference until one candidate holds more than half. Render the FINAL results board: the elected winner clearly marked with a WINNER badge, and the winner's and runner-up's final vote totals shown as printed numbers. Do not show intermediate rounds or any arrows.
easy_question: Never mind how well it is drawn. Does this picture show city-hall ranked-choice election results announcement board with a WINNER badge and printed final vote totals? A realistic photo, an illustration, a schematic or a clean diagram ALL count as yes. Answer NO only if the image instead shows just a blank card or plain panel that prints an answer with none of that shown, or shows something unrelated. Answer yes or no only.

steps.target: candidate name printed on the row of this results table that carries the winner badge

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed results board, showing part of one row of a table. A person's name is printed in it. Copy that name exactly as it is printed and write nothing else.

steps.target: vote total printed in the final-vote-total column, on the row of this results table that carries the winner badge -- draw ONE box on that printed number only, from its first digit to its last; do not box the candidate name on that row, do not box the WINNER badge itself, and do not box a number printed on a row that carries no winner badge.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed results board. One whole number is printed in it. Write down just that number, digits only, and nothing else.

steps.read_crop: This is a close-up cut from a printed results board. One whole number is printed in it. Write down just that number, digits only, and nothing else.
